is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis, a malaria vector.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports gene expression (transcriptional) data (microarray and qPCR) for detoxification genes, but does not report genotype data for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers (e.g., kdr, Ace-1, Rdl, etc.).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report genotype counts or frequencies for any resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Lower Moshi, Tanzania.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting microarray and qPCR experiments on field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections were made in Mabogini village, Lower Moshi, Tanzania.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary study reporting new gene expression data.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the transcriptional basis of pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles arabiensis from Lower Moshi, Tanzania, using microarray and qPCR. It does not genotype any insecticide-resistance markers.
